title: Simulated configuration encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $v$ and $x$ be finite Boolean strings, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $v$. For a natural number $i$ and a simulation phase $p$, define the corresponding configuration on input $x$ to have state $c$’s state paired with $p$ when $c$ is nonhalting, input-head position $1$, an added work tape containing the buffer representation of the binary expansion of $i$, the original work tapes, an added work-head position $0$, the original work-head positions, and the original output string.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $v$
